movelist.name: Fake Tears
movelist.effect: Lower the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Copycat
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Copycat cannot miss.

movelist.name: Electro Ball
movelist.effect: The user adds their Speed Stat, including Combat Stages, in addition to their Special Attack when determining the damage dealt by Electro Ball. The Defender in turn subtracts both their Special Defense and Speed Stats from the damage dealt before applying Type Effectiveness.

movelist.name: Switcheroo
movelist.effect: The user and the target exchange Held Items or Accessory Slot Items.

movelist.name: Encore
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the target becomes Confused; on a result of 3 or 4 the target becomes Suppressed; on a result of 5 or 6 the target becomes Enraged.

abilities.name: Minus
abilities.trigger: A foe within 10m has Combat Stages lowered
abilities.effect: The target loses an additional Combat Stage in one stat lowered by the triggering effect.

abilities.name: Sequence
abilities.trigger: The user uses an Electric Attack
abilities.effect: For every Electric-Type Pokémon adjacent to the user, the triggering Attack deals an additional +3 Damage.
